component.name: Money Manager
component.summary: Expenses, income and transfers across accounts

description.p: Keeps track of what you spend and earn, by category, across accounts in different currencies, with transfers between them. One adaptive window: a table on a desktop, a list on a phone, and the same three charts on both.
The ledger is a CRDT document kept inside the application. It can sync with any S3-compatible storage, end-to-end encrypted, and merges changes made on several devices without conflicts.
